statement: ∀ m p : ℕ, m≠0 → p.Prime → (m.factorization p - 1) = ((Finset.Icc 2 (m.factorization p)).filter (fun j => p^j ∣ m)).card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0021 · 逐层计数超出一次的素因子赋值
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0021 · Count excess valuations by prime-power layers

brief.zh: 将 p^j 整除替换为 j 至多等于赋值。
brief.en: Use the divisibility criterion j ≤ vₚ(m) for each layer.
